description: Memory facts of the ATmega328P: RAMEND, EEPROM size, flash size, stack and heap placement, EEPROM access.
basis: Recorded once on Arduino Uno R3 (genuine, USB 2341:0043) (serial output, arduino-cli 1.5.1, arduino:avr@1.8.8). Previous basis: ATmega328P datasheet and avr-libc iom328p.h: RAMEND 0x08FF = 2303, E2END 0x03FF = 1023, FLASHEND 0x7FFF = 32767, erased EEPROM reads 0xFF = 255; the stack starts at RAMEND, .bss starts above the 256-byte register and I/O space, malloc allocates between .bss and the stack
